Overview

San Cristóbal is a city in 21 with a population of 140,000. The birthplace of the Dominican constitution, a historic city with mountains and beaches nearby. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree.
